questions.question: What was the total number of Medicaid enrollees in California in 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_2024.csv')
ca_2024 = df[(df['State'] == 'California') & (df['Year'] == 2024)]
result = int(ca_2024['Total Medicaid Enrollees'].str.replace(',', '').iloc[0])

questions.question: In 2024, did Texas have more enrollees in comprehensive managed care than Florida?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_2024.csv')
tx = df[(df['State'] == 'Texas') & (df['Year'] == 2024)]['Medicaid Enrollment in Comprehensive Managed Care'].str.replace(',', '')
fl = df[(df['State'] == 'Florida') & (df['Year'] == 2024)]['Medicaid Enrollment in Comprehensive Managed Care'].str.replace(',', '')
result = 'yes' if int(tx.iloc[0]) > int(fl.iloc[0]) else 'no'

questions.question: Which three states had the highest enrollment in comprehensive managed care in 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_2024.csv')
d2024 = df[(df['Year'] == 2024) & (df['State'] != 'TOTALS')].copy()
col = 'Medicaid Enrollment in Comprehensive Managed Care'
d2024[col] = pd.to_numeric(d2024[col].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').replace('--', None), errors='coerce')
result = d2024.sort_values(by=col, ascending=False).head(3)['State'].tolist()

questions.question: In which year between 2016 and 2024 was total national Medicaid enrollment the highest?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_2024.csv')
totals = df[df['State'] == 'TOTALS'].copy()
totals['Total Medicaid Enrollees'] = totals['Total Medicaid Enrollees'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
max_year = totals.loc[totals['Total Medicaid Enrollees'].idxmax(), 'Year']
result = str(max_year)

questions.question: How many states or territories reported more than 5 million total Medicaid enrollees in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_2024.csv')
d2023 = df[(df['Year'] == 2023) & (df['State'] != 'TOTALS')].copy()
d2023['Total Medicaid Enrollees'] = d2023['Total Medicaid Enrollees'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
result = int((d2023['Total Medicaid Enrollees'] > 5000000).sum())
